reasoning_content: I keep making the same mistake of including a `description` field in my tool calls. The `terminal` tool only accepts `command` and `security_risk`. Let me be very careful and only include those two fields.

action.command: curl -s -X PUT "http://localhost:9200/spotify_tracks/_settings" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"index.number_of_replicas":0}'; echo; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health | python3 -c "import json,sys; print('cluster:', json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -s -X PUT \"http://localhost:9200/spotify_tracks/_settings\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"index.number_of_replicas\":0}'; echo; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health | python3 -c \"import json,sys; print('cluster:', json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])\"", "summary": "Set replicas to zero for green cluster", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
